# DOT Hazmat Transportation 10-Hour Advanced General Awareness Training

> 10-hour online training on the U.S. DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Parts 171-180) covering general awareness, function-specific, modal (highway, air, rail, vessel) and security awareness training. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 10 hours; 12 modules, 25 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 1.0 CEU
- Price: $290.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, on-demand webinar, virtual live and classroom formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years; renew by retaking the course
- DOT training timing: initial within 90 days of hire or job change; recurrent at least every three years

## Modules
1. Hazardous Materials Regulations (hazard classes; enforcing agencies PHMSA, FMCSA, FRA, FAA, USCG)
2. Hazardous Materials Table (Columns 1-10, Appendices A and B)
3. Shipping Papers
4. Packaging
5. Marking
6. Labeling
7. Placarding
8. Carrier Requirements: Highway (DOT and FMCSR)
9. Carrier Requirements: Air (FAA, IATA, ICAO differences)
10. Carrier Requirements: Rail (segregation, positioning placarded cars, AAR key trains)
11. Carrier Requirements: Water (stowage, segregation, IMDG vs. HMR, NRC reporting)
12. Security Awareness (security and safety plans, specific measures)

## Who should take it
Workers who load, unload or handle hazmat; shipment preparers; drivers; security personnel; manufacturers and testers of drums, cylinders and UN packaging; supervisors.
